summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package @ornikar/repo-config-react@13.0.18 is published as a React repo configuration preset but its npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<archive>.zip into a temp directory, chmods the extracted binary executable, and invokes it with execFileSync against a bundled 727KB sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is an obfuscator.io-style bundle with a rotating string array (WV8StW/MmgoCP shift loop, hc1jfK9 decoder) and no readable code. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers and per-scope string-lookup maps that hide the literals 'ldd', '/etc/os-release', 'Alpine', 'bun', and the GitHub download URL. Execution fires automatically on every npm install and executes the bundled payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. The stated purpose (React lint/config preset) does not require fetching a second language runtime or shipping a 727KB obfuscated bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
